name: Wakasa Hiroki
source:
"...It's just a superstition that forgetting God causes misery, right?"

A young man who is a newspaper reporter in Tokyo.

He is proud of his job as a reporter in pursuit of the truth, and because of his sense of justice, he was opposed to his company's stance of publishing only articles that fueled the war, but he was put on leave because he needed to recover from his injuries...

As a journalist, he believes it is his mission to let more people know what he is right about. He can't let go of the discriminatory words and deeds of the people of his hometown against the the people who "forgot God," and tries to dispel their prejudice.

[Translated from [url=http://dswtc.web.fc2.com/game/getemono/getemono.html]official website[/url]]
